I created `docs/policies/version-scheme.md`. It says that no decision on the version numbering scheme is currently recorded.

I wrote it that way because the project's memory holds no decision on versioning. The only related entries are two one-word chat remarks, "calver" and then "semver". They were logged as things said, not as decisions, so I didn't treat either as current. The file names neither scheme.

The first attempt to create the file with a shell command failed with a parser error, so I used the Write tool instead. The file was written that way.

The memory system's heartbeat also reported 20 hook runs that started and never finished. That points to a hook exceeding its timeout. I didn't investigate it.
